title: Three Standout Female Anime Leads of 2026: Yamada, Coco and Sitara
excerpt:
A new editorial feature highlights three very different female protagonists.
The selection is critical commentary, not an official industry ranking.
body_md:
A ComicBook editorial has highlighted three female anime protagonists from 2026 whose stories demonstrate the range of roles women can occupy in a medium often associated with male-led shonen adventures.

Yamada from Smoking Behind the Supermarket with You is presented as a grounded, multifaceted character. Her gentle supermarket persona contrasts with a cooler alter ego, while her relationship with Sasaki emphasizes mutual support rather than reducing her to a conventional love interest.

Coco from Witch Hat Atelier represents determination and curiosity. Her desire to understand magic propels the narrative, and her refusal to surrender when faced with obstacles gives her the resilient qualities often associated with classic shonen heroes.

Sitara from Jaadugar: A Witch in Mongolia follows a very different path. After suffering the loss of people close to her, she pursues a politically charged struggle against the Mongol Empire from a position of extreme vulnerability.

The article argues that these protagonists broaden the storytelling possibilities of anime. Its three selections are the writer's own critical choices rather than the outcome of an award or industry-wide survey.
